justification.statement: generators with disjoint supports commute, and a swap of neighbouring letters keeps the letters a word holds
justification.text: If g and h move disjoint sets of slots, g then h and h then g are the same permutation, so swapping them changes no effect; and a swap never changes which letters a word holds. The supports are the model's.

reason.statement: generators with disjoint supports commute, and a swap of neighbouring letters keeps the letters a word holds
reason.idea: Two twists that touch no common sticker can be done in either order, so two words that differ only by such swaps are the same word for every purpose of the effect.
